summary: Transfer a current representation of the target resource.
Same as GET but the response has no body; used to read headers and check existence.
Process the request body according to the semantics of the target resource, for example create a resource or start an action.
Replace the state of the target resource with the request body, creating it when it does not exist.
Remove the association between the target URI and its resource.
Establish a tunnel to the destination server; used by proxies.
Describe the communication options available for the target resource.
Perform a message loop-back test along the path to the target resource.
Apply a partial modification to the target resource.
